summary: Equitable Holdings filed an 8-K solely to set the date, time, and record date for its 2026 annual meeting of stockholders (September 23, 2026; record date August 7, 2026) and to update the deadlines for stockholder proposals and director nominations under Rule 14a-8 and the company's advance notice bylaws. The filing is a routine administrative notice under Item 8.01, containing no special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, or management change. It is a governance logistics update with no deal terms, transaction mechanics, or strategic review elements.
